scope: Use Apple Human Interface Guidelines as a usability reference for this Linux/Omarchy suite; preserve Enochian artwork and Linux shortcut/window conventions. No macOS visual styling or API compliance is claimed. Frozen evaluation anchors and weights remain unchanged.

checks.principle: Keep frequent actions direct and avoid unnecessary dialog layers.
checks.application: The primary Open control requests the native simple-file dialog. Ctrl+O was observed opening a direct picker. Other Open Media/Add and advanced routes remain available; preserve native cancellation and Linux conventions. Companion Play and Show file remain direct actions.

checks.principle: Provide familiar command access and keyboard routes.
checks.application: Preserve Linux/VLC shortcuts and verify keyboard transport, Escape cancellation, focus order and return focus.

checks.principle: Use familiar file navigation and clear preservation outcomes.
checks.application: Verify file identity, named playlist export/reopen, destination selection and cancel without changes.

checks.principle: Let users control window layout and full-screen transitions.
checks.application: Check normal/compact, full-screen exit and playback continuity using VLC and Omarchy conventions.

checks.principle: Keep essential controls reachable when content takes focus.
checks.application: Verify native keyboard/context-menu playback and full-screen controls rather than adding decorative overlays.

checks.principle: Maintain readable information density and precise input.
checks.application: Check real labels, resized original controls, truthful piece inventory and clear selected-file states in both finishes.
